title: Small, and the Words That Never Change
label: ch:mr-invariable-adjectives
canDo: I can call a thing small or beautiful, and I can tell from an adjective's last letter whether it will take an ending at all.

payoff.summary: Complete MR-R50-small and put all three adjectives on khoolī, naming which one changed and why.
payoff.note: The invariable class is taught immediately after the agreeing one because a learner who meets only moTHaa over-applies its endings; the contrast is the teaching.
